plate: Locked orthographic camera, fixed anatomical scale and centred body. Keep the full head, the whole crossbow, the coat tails, limbs and boots within frame. idle_h3_v1.action: A ready, watchful idle that loops. She breathes, shifts her weight, lets the crossbow swing a little at her hip and resettles her grip, glances to the side and the coat tails and scarf stir, then everything returns smoothly to the original stance. Both boots stay planted. No walking and no shooting.

attack_h3_v1.action: Make ONE punch toward screen right. She draws her empty fist back to her shoulder as the knees bend, then lunges forward and drives it straight out to full reach at screen right, the crossbow held low in the other hand, draws back and settles into the original stance. One punch only; no effect at contact.

ranged_h3_v1.action: Shoot ONE bolt toward screen right. She raises the crossbow to her shoulder with both hands and sights along it toward screen right, the string snaps forward and the crossbow kicks back, then she reaches over her shoulder to draw a fresh bolt from the quiver, sets it in place and lowers the crossbow to her hip in the original stance. One shot only; the bolt is never shown in flight, with no muzzle flash, fire, smoke or trail.

hit_h3_v1.action: She starts rocked back in a flinch and recovers from it. Her head and shoulders are thrown back, the coat swings and the knees buckle while the hand keeps hold of the crossbow, then she steadies on both boots and returns to the same stance. Only the body moves; nothing else appears in the frame.

defend_h3_v1.action: Crouch low with the crossbow held across the body and raise the free forearm over the head as a guard, then hold the guarded crouch on both planted boots. No shooting and no return to the relaxed stance.

cast_h3_v1.action: A rallying signal. She raises her empty fist high above her head, the crossbow held low in the other hand, holds the pose briefly, then lowers the arm back to the original stance. A physical gesture only: no spell, glow or aura.

death_h3_v1.action: Collapse slowly. She sinks down onto her knees with the crossbow dropping, stays there a moment, then slumps onto her side and lies flat, finishing motionless with her head at screen left and her boots at screen right, the crossbow lying on the ground beside her. The body never leaves the ground; no recovery, no floating equipment and no disappearing body.
